ops_oncall_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: sudden spike in kv-cache evictions in us-west-2 affecting hosted text-generation requests. Elevated latencies and some 5xxs. Creating thread and paging oncall.
jamie_ops: seeing increased p95 on generation routes, confirmed via grafana -> query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m])) by (pool)` — us-west-2 pool ~6x baseline.
nisha_sre: adding traces. Top correlation: requests with long contexts triggering cache churn. Example log snippet:
```
[2026-02-28T14:12:03Z] shard-7 evictions/sec=243 miss_rate=0.41 active_sessions=1200
```
alex_r: rolling out quick mitigation: reduce `kv_cache_max_entries` from 200k -> 500k on the affected worker pool to slow eviction pressure. Doing a staged restart on pool nodes.
emily_prod: status page updated: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1769004321 — impact: increased latency for hosted text-generation in us-west-2, partial error spikes. ETA mitigation in progress.
sre_lead: any customer-facing incidents reported yet? tag CS if needed.
customer_success: a couple of customers pinged through support with higher latencies, no major outages reported. We're prepping an advisory message.
jamie_ops: mitigation step 1 applied to 3/5 nodes in us-west-2. Observing drop in evictions on those nodes within 90s. p95 lat down ~30% on patched nodes.
nisha_sre: continuing diag to root cause — hypothesis: recent model quantization change increased per-request KV footprint causing faster cache churn for long-context requests.
alex_r: if the staged change stabilizes, next step is a controlled config change to increase global cache size and apply a small request-level prefix-caching optimization. Will coordinate with infra team.
emily_prod: status page note: "Mitigation in progress — staged config changes rolled out to subset of nodes; monitoring." Customer advisory draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft/incident-1769004321 (internal)
sre_lead: assign postmortem owner please. Also schedule canary for the cache config before global rollout.
jamie_ops: postmortem owner: nisha_sre. Action items: 1) revert the quantization change for the problematic model variant (if confirmed) 2) add a KV cache size auto-scale job 3) add alerting for eviction-rate spikes > 3x baseline for >2min.
customer_success: sending interim note to impacted customers pointing to status page and estimated time to stability.
jamie_ops: final update: all nodes in us-west-2 now on the revised `kv_cache_max_entries`. Evictions back to baseline and error spike subsided. Rolling closes in 5m and will keep additional monitoring for 24h. :white_check_mark:
ops_oncall_bot: Incident resolved signal detected at 1769005521 — closing thread. Postmortem request created: https://redwood.internal/pm/1769004321-postmortem
